Visits with Crimson
Quote
~ ~ ~

I looked casually over my shoulder as one does when someone familiar calls their name. I saw two faces, no, wait, three, all smiling. Why would they be so happy, I wondered? Was it not just moment ago I witnessed a man fall, knife pointing high out of his ribs? Yes, I wasnt delusional, I did see the man fall, and he did have a knife wedged in his now carcass. So how could three faces be smiling so?
The answer wouldnt come for some moments, perhaps two or three, but I regret the moment I wished I knew, for knowing was something not all men were meant to do. I turned and faced those three smiling faces, to find them attached to a neck and body. I looked at their clothes, clean suits, freshly pressed. Small black lines ran up their slacks and suits, pinstripes I believed they are called. As I looked down at my silhouette reflecting in their shoes, I saw one foot move in a peculiar way.
It twisted over, with the heel being the load bearer of the leg. I pondered how one could not scream, until I looked up, and saw no man can scream in such a state. The smiles were gone on all but one face, and the one smiling was the only one still in his place.
The other two fell, their suits cushioning the fall; a gentle thud accompanied them on their way down. I then finally stopped looking at the face, and looked past it to see two eyes staring at me. I looked down again, at my silhouette still in his shoes, but this time I was not perfectly portrayed. A drop of blood fell in my figures way. I looked for its source, and found it not concealed.
The knife, no, a knife, as corpse number one still held his trophy high. The man must have brought a pair. This one was stained so red, an apple would look pale. As the blood from his like dressed friends slid off its edge, I finally started to piece what had happened together. The man took no time ending this however, as his thirsty knife met my quenching flesh.
I felt no pain as the knife drowned itself in my ribs, they say your life flashes before your eyes, and they apparently dont lie.

~ ~ ~

Quote
I woke up from a shallow sleep. My eyes didnt need to adjust to the dark of night because a light shone from underneath my door. It was a red light, but I wasnt scared. I was excited. I got my blue flashlight out from under my bed and flick the enlarged plastic switch. The beam of light streaked out across the room, illuminating a pair of hands on the wall.
The hands show me what I want to see and I am reluctant to see my waiting has not been rewarded yet. My light is flicked off by my finger and the covers placed back over my head. I had to sleep, or my reward would never come said my dad. He was always right then, that would change unfortunately.
My eyes closed only to open again at the sound Ive never heard. It came from the hallway, this I was certain. My hand darted toward the flashlight to see the telling hands again. This time they proved favorable, it was finally tomorrow, finally Christmas. I darted out of the room, my plaid pajamas following me down the stairs. The tree was lit up brilliantly, full of red and white lights. I glance under the tree, and to my dismay, find it empty. How could it be? I wonder internally. My hands had led me astray; I cursed the first curse to ever leave my lips. I cursed my hands to hell, and cursed them never to return. Maybe I was endowed with magical powers, because my hands would fail me for the rest of my life, what little life I ended up having. My sock clad feet led me down the hallway, still draped in red from the brilliant tree.
I hear that sound again and a cautious hello? escapes my mind and leaves my lips. Nothing comes back from the sound, but its location has been narrowed down. The end of the hall was its source, I remember that much.
Why was I having this flashback, this part of my life wasnt Important? In my dieing breath I want to remember the important moments in my life. Not my pointless Christmas with my family when I was 6. Maybe my mind had already failed itself, and importance wasnt important anymore. My flashback continued.
I woke up from a shallow sleep. No Ive done this already, it wasnt important the first time, nor will it be the subsequent times I have it brought before my fading mind. I heard the sound I third time. This is better, what happened next? Again, words I should have not uttered were, Who is there?
My socks scuttled past my room, the flashlights light shining through the open door. My shadow looked ominous in the hall, which wasnt surprising. I still didnt see why I was having this memory, why was it so predominant in my mind? Whatever, lets end it so I can move onto more important moments in my life.
My eyes shifted side to side, so that no crease in the blue patterned wallpaper escaped observation. My eyes shifted to my parents room, it looked fine, just as it always had on nights I was out of my room past the hands pointing up. Cursed hands, I was still furious towards them, always pointing me in misleading ways.
Nevertheless, the sound thudded for my ears again. It shouldnt have though, for my sake. The location known to me, just beyond the door I was forbade from opening. My parents room looked normal, but most things do when given only a quarter inch from the bottom side of door to look through. The floor looked flat and smooth; the imperfections in the carpet didnt show up in the nonexistent light. The door handle held my image, twisted around its many facets and curves. I stared intently at it in the red light, my face barely discernable.
Why on Earth wouldnt this memory end? It was dragging on like the death I was suffering. End already, just end for the sake of me. My mind apparently wasnt completely lost, as it begrudgingly refused to release my eyes from this memory. I cursed my mind too; maybe my powers had carried on through the years, apparently not.
The door handle turned easy enough, I wished now it hadnt. My eyes spent no time adjusting to the lack of light, however they should have. The sheets I saw were stained red, but the tree was no where in sight. Peculiar thing was, my father sitting there was stained red too, along with my mother. Only one red figure was moving though, why not both, I had wondered then?
Unfortunately, the sheets and my parents werent the only thing stained red that night, our kitchen knife shared the same hue as everything else in the room near the bed. Again, my lips failed to withhold the vibrations my mind conjured, Daddy? my imbecile six year old mind inquired.
Ive never seen eyes turn as fast as they did there. A smile, no a frown, no nothing shown on my dads face. Blankness covered the red on his face, and fear covered the white on mine. My lips finally succeeded in entrapping words my mind wished to invoke, however this too would fail me.
Had I cursed my lips too, maybe I was the one cursed, and me cursing any part of me did nothing but formalize the already existing hex? This thought blazed through the memory, to my eyes pleasure. Anything to encompass the flashback was a favor, and anything had come to my rescue. It was over, I could tell, as my next flashback started as quickly as the other had subsided.

~ ~ ~

#53270 34 2005-03-08T22:46:57Z maximo
Woo for part three. And as a note... I jsut got done proofreading it and haven't had time to actually change them (I proof read on paper, then go in and change) and I'm pressed for time.

and enjoy.

Quote
Free from my first flashback, my mind raced through my forgettable youth.  It stopped fast forwarding when I was thirteen.  Apparently thirteen is unlucky, as I was about to experience.  Again, my silent scream to my mind fell on deaf ears, as if it mattered.  One rarely wins a battle against ones own mind, when his mind is all he has left.  If I had won against my mind, my life would cease to flash, and my life would cease to be, something rather un-tragic I might add. 
Well, my thirteen year old eyes peered over a thirteen year olds body.  I must have forgotten to get dressed that day, as my clothes found shelter on the floor of my room.  My blue jeans must have found a date, as they sat entwined with a pair of panties that didnt originate from my wardrobe.  My eyes found my companion again, and I found, no felt that my pants werent the only thing entwined tightly together.  My hands found sweaty company with the unclad back of the person I was coming to know so well. 
I know why I had this flashback; I was expecting it before it happened in fact.  Virginity takes no time to loose and forever to keep.  I however, found forever too long, and opted for thirteen years, three months and one hundred fifty seven days instead.  Much easier that way.  Ha, smugness in the moments of death.  I wonder if everyone feels this during the highlight reel of their life at some point or another.  It matters not, I felt it, and I was glad I did.  Now, back to my flashback, this was one I was hoping would be in vivid detail.
My eyes peered down, clouded by sweat.  My room had never been so hot; it was in the basement, I thought basements were cool?  What was her name though?  Oh crap I forgot.  Only 24 years had passed and I forgot her name.  I only hoped she didnt bump into me in the afterlife, assuming I would find one of course.  Crap, why cant I focus on this memory, the other one was in such detail, why cant this one share the same fate?
My eyes peered down, clouded by sweat, my room still hot as before.  The radio in the background produced noises, but my focus was not on it, and the waves fell on my ears, but never reached my brain.  My brain was focused on something at that time, and it was focused on something wrong.  I had a beautiful nameless woman in my room, along with her clothes.  However she abandoned them and put me on instead.  How could I focus on the red drop on my sheet at a moment like this? 
I didnt know what it had come from, and in all honestly, I didnt matter.  I wanted something at that moment in my life.  Release was the only thing in my life worth fighting for.  My father failed to father me, and my mother failed to out live my youth.  Live isnt the right word, she didnt fail to live, she failed to survive.  Survive is what you do when you are attacked.  I guess no one really lives a life.  We all just survive it.  I was in the slow process of failing that task, quite coincidentally in much the same way my mother had failed herself.
Off topic again, the red stain, was fresh.  I could tell, from the fact that the fabric hadnt absorbed it into its weave yet.  The oblong circle stretching precariously towards my hand drew all my attention.  I heard my name though.  I wasnt the only one who was aware I was lacking focus.  She looked up at me, silently pleading for me to continue.
Metal, I soon learned, did a poor job of drowning out giggles and moans pleasure.  I didnt learn from the fact that my dad had heard us in the basement over the music, I learned from the fact that our neighbors heard my moans and cries over the music a house away.  Dirt and Metal hold that quality together, as both together couldnt conceal the events that afternoon. 
Why didnt I wait till night? my mind thought in its fleeting moments of consciousness that day.  In between my companion disengaging her undergarments from my denim and my eye lid turning a more intense shade of purple I discovered something paramount.  Never trust in a father whos only redeeming quality is his consistent inconstancy.  My father, more specifically his hands met my face in a more personal way than I could ever imagine. 
That lone dot of crimson on my bed soon found many friends, and they collected joyously beneath my head.  My sheets became like an open wound, overflowing with the deep scarlet of the viscous fluid.  My dad took up my former position over another person, only we were entangled in a less affectionate way.  Unless of course you define affection on physical contact alone.  Under that definition, we were far more affectionate at that moment than any other moment of my life. 
I was not to be outdone though.  Even in an unconscious state, my flashback remembered something I didnt remember then.  My dad, who had used me for a scapegoat with mom, now found my new rape victim his lamb for this act.  Only she would be less lucky than I.  Lambs live for one purpose, and that is slaughter, she would be no exception to this.  Of course, I hadnt raped her; my father would set it up that way.  I was never one to enjoy malice, but my father relished in it.  My dad was wise in one way.  He could piece together a crime scene before the crime had even happened.  His talents were well practiced, and it showed that day.  Had I only cursed his hands, and not my own. 
Had my female accomplice only left my pants and her garments together, she wouldnt have had to be dubbed a lamb in my memory.  I gained semi consciousness just as my dad had finished systematically making my rape of this innocent teen turned fatal brawl into a figment of reality.  I looked at my dads cursed orbs for eyes.  I saw my distorted reflection again, but I also saw what I couldnt have seen had it not been for the reflective quality of his eyes.  Most eyes hold some reflective sheen to them, but his were as emotionless mirrors, and they revealed what my victim had come to.
Her sweat was replaced with beads of red.  I never knew one to sweat red, but I guess all things were possible in the mind of a killed man.  My mind was fooling me.  I wasnt dead yet.  I knew this from the fact that I was still holding thoughts.  Or maybe that is an illusion of death.  If eternity was exclusively memory of ones life, then Hell would be a freedom for me.
My eyes again fell upon my dads eyes my face now distorted by the red in my own eye.  Red has always had the ability to distort in my life.  I guess my flashback wouldnt let me forget such a thing.  My flashback stopped suddenly.  My mind sighed, weather or not that is possible is meaningless though.  It sighed a sigh of relief, however it quickly found the fast forward button again, and my teen years flew by.  Juvenile hall was strictly white anyways.

~ ~ ~

Quote
I wanted my flashbacks to stop.  No part of my life I was soon learning would ever be worth watching again.  I despised my life and cursed it to hell.  Maybe I was already there?  After all this is the most miserable Ive ever been.  Its as if my mind choose to pick the most gruesome moments in my life and play them in sequence, with my eyes taped open, hands and feet tied down. 
Well, not really tied, more like powerless or stiff.  They were caressed by no bonds, but they were obviously beyond finite use to me now.  What my next flashback would be, I wondered, juvenile hall skirmishes flashing before me as if in a strobe light.  Frame by frame they flickered; only many frames were missing.  Faces held no features, and fists held no pain.  Just images from my youth, untouched by my now forbade hue of red.
If there was any color I now hated more it was crimson.  But not just any crimson, no, not the crimson Crayola packages right next to red.  No, this crimson shines in the light and glares in the dark.  It holds no emotion, yet stirs up so many.  If ever the rainbow were to miss a color, I would vote this friend of scarlet out before one could murmur its name.
Wait, was I really apposed to this shade, or was my true resentment placed in what it came from.  It came from daggers, fists, and knifes.  How come they have all been in the hands of my father?  Maybe he was the source of my scourging.  Maybe my lifes strife ran from his lifes chaos?  I dont know if there is a chaos gene, but I think my life received one from him. 
How I hated that man.  Life was something to be cherished, revered even, but he used it like a razor.  If it isnt any good to him anymore, it was more easily replaced than restored.  How could he hold life in such disregard?  One life is all he had, and he spent it destroying others.  Maybe he reasoned that the more lives he destroys, the more life he can take for himself.  But how could anyone short of the insane conjure up ideas such as these? 
Ah yes, but he is insane isnt he.  Maybe I too was insane, for not realizing this sooner.  Had I realized this 15 minutes short of my incising, my flashbacks may have proved more rational and less fervent to the disdained hue of red.  How funny I was.  Did I not just realize my discourse from life was not maneuvered by crimson, only tarnished with it along every step?  Yet here my mind stood, however impractical, on the assumption still that crimson was the origin of my abysmal dismay.
It has been a while since I last encountered a segment of life my mind found horrific enough to replay for the private screening of my tortuous life.  Where was I now?  My gosh, still trapped in juvie!  What is this, slow motion?  I must be what, 18 now, yea, I can tell.  I got out of that desolate chasm of bleached walls and ceilings.  The only colors originating with the food, even if its flavor was as vibrant as the dcor.  I was talking about his all in the present, why?  This happened years ago, was it really that prominent in my life?  I dont remember one life altering thing every happening those few years of my life. 
Either way, it was all second to what my mind was gong to focus on next.  I couldnt forget it, even if I had cursed my memory.  Some memories burn not just holes, but scars into your mind, and scars never fade from the mind.  They linger and the pain is regurgitated time and time again until the taste is so familiar, you define your life on it.  Pain so harsh and numbing at the same time I fell crippled time and time again to its ensnaring sting.
As if by design my mind stopped its skim of my formal imprisoned life and started with my mentally incarcerated life.  If ever there was a checkpoint in my life that held a turn in trends, this was it.  As my accursed mind would hold in the spotlight, hopefully for no longer than an instant, as if my  mind ever cooperated with me.
And with this looming memory, loading into my minds tape player, ready to be projected before my lidless eyes, I realized I was as helpless now as I was when I was birthed.  Nothing I could do now would stop it, and nothing I willed now would be granted.  My mind hit play, and my post life would stop, until the last frame rolled, and the screen fades to black.

~ ~ ~

#75511 48 2005-06-16T23:53:02Z maximo
What I have so far... only one list but it's a start.

Top Ten Ways

Not to make a map harder:
10.) Length. Long maps get tedious and old really fast. Hard maps that are long become frustrating because dieing at the end means you have do a very long part of the level over again. A well known example is MTI. Which I know is considered good, but it is still very frustrating to die at the last room and have to do the whole thing over 50 times. Also Bricklayer is a good example. While not long in the length of the tile set it has far too many switches all over the map that it becomes one of the longest maps in the game. Do not put tons of switches on your maps or they quickly become too long for tastes.
9.) Cluster enemies. Large groups of things like turrets are excessive and pointless. One of two things happen, they all act like one enemy and you just extend the load time or it becomes frustratingly luck based. When there are large swarms of enemies or lots of turrets the game because mostly chance. While this can work in some instances, 9 times out of 10 it is very bad to group and cluster enemies. One or two well placed drones are always better than 10 seeking drones coming at you right away.
8.) Gauss Turrets in the middle of open maps or in the corners of small or narrow spaces. This while not always bad can very quickly become very very very frustrating. Without places to hide or at least get its fire off of you the map quickly becomes luck because Gauss are widely renowned as most random of all enemies. You can do everything right, go fast and keep going back and forth and the gauss will still get you some of the time, which in my experience is one of the most frustrating things ever. Instead of the middle of open spaces, try in a small crevice so the player has a chance to get behind or besides it and be safe.
7.) Grouping certain enemies in the same space. This is open for debate, but from my point of view there are 2 groups of enemies, smart and dumb. Smart enemies include things like rockets, gauss, and seeker drones. They actively pursue you at all times and react to you. Dumb enemies are ones like laser drones, chain gun drones, zap drones, and thwumps. Once they see you they dont stop their attack and start looking for you again until it is over, giving you ample opportunity to get away. Ive always found grouping any dumb enemy with smart enemies is a no no and just makes the map insanely hard. The lasers or chain guns trap you in place while you wait for them to stop attacking while the seeking enemies come and get you while you are pinned down. Instead put like grouped things together and youll end up with more beatable, yet still challenging maps.
6.) Awkward or trick jumps. Things like this take time and some level of luck to pull off. Having to jump from a steep slope, and wall jump off of a one way wall then land on the edge of a half wall just to turn and see the rocket on your tail is just too hard. Instead focus on smooth transitions from the different places on your map and places that are easy to get around in. Nothing is worse than having to make split second jumps one after another. Things that require exacting precision from start to finish are very frustrating. Instead try to make maps with many open paths and ways for the player to recover after a slip. I guess a way to sum this is up is dont make unforgiving maps and try not to make maps with tricky terrain to walk on (especially when you do that with smart enemies).
5.) Segment your levels. A long group of medium difficulty rooms does not make a medium difficulty map. It makes a near impossible map. Having to do room after room or section after section of tedious challenges is a drag. While each room is beatable as a whole the chances of doing it all in one clean run becomes very minute. Just because you can spawn at each room and do them individually it gets really old having to do the first four rooms 10 times in order to get to the fifth room and die until you get finally get it. Then repeat for room six and so on. Not fun and very time consuming. Instead try to make maps were there a few enemies and section and the few enemies carry on and are used through out the map.
4.) Guess and check. Do not under any circumstances make a map that requires the player to guess in order to beat the level. This is a cardinal sin in my opinion. It is no fun at all for anyone to have to pick between 3 switches with all but one leading to certain doom. Always make sure the player knows what does what in a map. If a switch opens drones and there is no way for the player to avoid the switch or they have to guess which one is the one that opens the door to the exit it is annoying. It doesnt make maps hard, it makes them boring. Instead of a good challenge the player guesses wrong, dies and then next time its the easiest map in the world. Easy ways out of this are simply no to do it. But if you just have to make it so the player doesnt die right away, just make it so it is harder later on. Never make it so guessing wrong makes the level impossible.
3.) Hidden traps. Nothing is fun about going for gold and then being stuck behind a trap door. It is worse than guess and check because you are supposed to go for gold as an extra challenge for those players who are up to it. Its so freaking frustrating to finally get that really hard to reach piece of gold only to find it kills you or traps you. Provide a way out at least. Getting harder for getting gold is a good thing, but getting impossible is a very bad thing that should be avoided 100% of the time.
2.) Small spaces and certain enemies. While some enemies work well in small spaces, some do not. Enemies that can be predicted like zap drones, thwumps, and in some instances gauss (emphasis on some) work well in small rooms where maneuverability is low things like rockets and lasers are just man slayers in small rooms. It makes the map no fun to play if the player knows it will take a very lucky run to get through certain rooms and putting something like a chain gun drone in the middle of a 3 by 3 room is just no way to do it. This is one of the more flexible things however because all of these enemies can work in certain situation, just some ore more apt to being a pain in the butt than a good time.
1.) There and Back missions. Oh my gosh, these are the absolute worst maps ever. Do not make maps that make you go through a drawn out corridor only to have to return the same way. Metanet did this a lot in the 70s column and it my least favorite column in the game. Having to traverse a series of tough challenges only to have to do the same thing coming back is annoying, repetitive, and takes a certain level of luck. Do not make the player play the same places on the map more than once. I dont care if you added enemies and it got harder (which is worse actually) it still sucks. Just dont do it, ever. Make maps where you go in a proverbial loop and go all over the map and end up back where you were if you want a long map.

As a note, all of these rules can be broken. In moderation of course but there is nothing saying you can do anyone of these things. Rules are made to be broken and these are no exception. If you do break these do so in moderation and do so only for a short period of time and do not break more than one or two at a time. Maps on NUMA these days are progressively reaching impossible heights of difficulty and its a shame to see some many good ideas fall to the wayside because they are too hard. Just play test a lot because this is the only way to tell if you have a good map and what needs to be changed. If you cant do it, neither can we.

Ups:

-It does show the maps worth playing
-much faster to use than the old system
-cool conectivity with the real game (DL userlevel docs and what not)

Downs:

-I don't want to put 4n maps in my favorites list. My favorites list is only for maps I really want to play again. I might like to rate the map so it gets a good rating, but I don't ever want to play it again. Even some maps I would give a solid 5 have a chance of not making it into my favorites list because there are somethings I want to play once, only once, and never again. This is a huge flaw from my standpoint because now average or even good maps loose taste in some peoples eyes. This is an all or nothing voting system which I don't like. If I voted every map I liked, my favorites list isn't anything useful anymore. It's just a hodgepodge of decent maps with a few gems in there. I want all gems in a list that I call my favorites. If I put decent maps in there than it's just like a condensed numa, which is useful but not that useful
-I view map pages to see what the map looks like, I might have no interest in playing it after I look at it, for whatever reason. This lowers the rating when I might infact like it when I get around to playing it. I dunno if that makes sense but the way I surf Numa is not conducive to this system
-ten views is a lot

I dunno, I'm not a huge fan, but it has some big perks over the old system.

In my own words, Insanity is any incapacity inabling the person to process or produce information in a manner coherent enough to be readily understood by others.

I don't feel that things like insomnia (just a random example) are insanity, whereas parts of RR's discription would lead one to believe they are. I would confine Insanity strickly to information processing and compiling, and not to social imbalances such as the aforementioned insomnia. I mean sure it is a condition of the mind but it doesn't in anyway inhibit the person's ability to rationalize or reason.

#83976 58 2005-07-16T16:12:30Z maximo
Well Sweep... My first official judging is neigh...

Sweep - Mile High Club

Appearance - 3
It was between a 3 and a 4, but I think the trap door switches look weird so you lost the point. The rocket room looks really cool and the three launch pad configuration on the right was nice.

Loading time/lag - 4
almost a bar, and you set the high standards. It's hard for me to judge lag because my PC runs so fast... (5 ms/f solid)

Ease of use - 6
the catapult was super easy to use... the rockets were easy to dodge until you tried harder moves (expected and a bonus) but the fact that after you use some things you can't again makes it frustrating some times. I wanted to use the top room again and really couldn't Putting a one way exit out of the top as a second way out would have been preferable


Fun factor (how fun is it to play?) - 15
Some spots are a little tricky to negotiate (mostly on the right, and the bottom loop is sorta awkward) and that's distracting. Otherwise this map is great fun to mess around on.


Quality & Quantity of cool stuff N can do on the map - 21
It was gonna be lower because of the fact that you only get to do it once, but the rocket room could be a park all in it's own. It was just great quality and you can do 100's off different dodges in there between the rockets. Outside of that room you have a good use of thwumps and jump pads to further your score


Ninja rating - 3
I dunno, it's just a 3...


Originality (pretty self explanatory) - 10
The design on the rocket room was good. The use of traps was cool (once... I'm not letting you off the hook for that, who skates so they can hit a cool trick once?) the tiles on the top left were uninspirered though


Overall thoughts on map - 5
It's a good first entry, and a good bit of flow in the map, but some choppy parts really distract from what the map could be. And you know how I feel about the trap doors... but that's another story! Good map, not great.


TOTAL - 67

#84253 31 2005-07-17T17:50:23Z maximo
Message board games dieing

This my freinds, is the picturesque anology to the love of two people in the jungle we call jokingly "High School." You say what, please don't do crack in front of the kids, but no, it makes so much sense it overflows the bowels of sense's intestines, leaving no room for anything but sense itself. Message board games dieing. For a game to die it first must be born. Not birthed like a mother from a womb, but like a flower from a bud. It is fathomed and bestowed upon the boards like a gift for all to see, a tabernacle of intrest, an alter of joy, and epiphany of excitment. What rules are there, what is the catch, will it catch on, the intrege and suspense builds until it is tested and tried. One hick up there and one snag there isn't enough to stop it's monumenteous rise to the top. Post after post filled with laughter and acronyms of people rolling on floors or parts of the rear fallin off or just audibly expressing laughter to the monitor. Smilies abound and jokes fly like a kite on a sweet spring day. It is much the same way love is birthed in the jungle. A man sees a woman, and from the vine that is his mind a bud is spawned. He walks up to said attraction, passionatly hoping the bud will bloom. She replies with a joke, an intrest returned. The first few petals of a deep and lasting relationship begin to emerge, vibrant with hope of a perfect future, long lasting and full of happieness and laughs. You begin to spend every moment with the person much the way you spend every day checking the game to see the jokes. Eagerly anticipating mere glances of her in the canopy of lockers and freinds. You can tell her from her hair half way around the world, even if you're blind and deaf and can't smell very well. So intense is your growing passion it requires more buds and flowers bloom like a sweet smeeling desert after a downpour. You say something dumb, you forget your axe (heaven's forebid) and you smell like man, you hit on her freind kinda in a way only she understands, it doesn't matter, it kills a few flowers but the fields still overflow with desire. How you found her, one doesn't know. Amidst a pack of blood thirsty leaches and wolve you found an innocent sheep wanting to be saved, and you sir are a savior to all sweet and defenseless sheep you are. But then something changes in the life of message board games. They begin to become repetative and instead of smilies you get frownies and brownies (the stinky variety) and the humor dries up like a river without a spring, or a yard in Arizona. Things once funny become dull like a knife used to kill too many chickens. The game slowly dwindles in posts and it soon drops down the page. Sure it may sputter once and a while, but they are flashes in the pans. Things like the "glory days" start being brought up, even if the thread lasted a mere week. You reminesce, and you sig the quotes and you move onto new games and new fun and fresh experiences, hardly remembering "that one game way back when". Such is love, the flowers begin to wither amidst the squelching heat of PMS and freinds who hate you for being a man and nothing else (they don't even know your name). Your calls are answered days later instead of moments, your smiles returned with grins, y our grins with frowns, tears with laughter (girls are bitter man). Your valley of fresh flowers dies one by one till only a pile of rot is left, and what a stinking baggage filled pile it is. You can't light it on fire less the fumes kill some animal that offends some hippie who sues you. You live with it under your bed... making you wash your sheets every three hours just to stand the pungent smell . You begin to realize that the sheep isn't good because it's a sheep, but because it has soft fir. So you skin it and make a coat instead. A very soft coat and you show it off to your freinds as a trophy. You hardly desire to remember anything but the soft wool and you despise all of her freinds now too (they were the wolves, so in reality you never liked them, unless they were good looking). In this way, love in the jungle we call "high school" can be summed up by the life and death of a message board game. Tears may flow like streams abundant, but tears only make the ground muddy, and no one likes mud.

#84356 27 2005-07-18T05:28:51Z maximo
Great_Sea said something important I want to elaborate on.

Don't create love. Don't look for it, don't try to find it, don't immage it. Let it find you. When you look for something, you tend to find what you look for, it's just the way it works. So if you go into relationships looking to find love, you will most likely end up in love, but just you, and not her. Wait until love smacks you in the face so hard that you can't help but step back and just admire how beautiful it is. When you get smacked like this (and you'll know), cling to it and fight for it, love it back the same way it loves you. Keep and open eye for love, but don't keep an open telescope, if that makes any sense at all. You have a heart that wants deeply just to love someone for how they are, and to have those feelings returned. Love everyone this way, and when you find the people who make you fele that way back, deepen your relationship and see where it goes. I find it's bad to ahve a plan in relationships about when you'll do this or that in a relatioship. Set up what you do and do not want to do in a relationship, and then live inside that little fence. Love can flourish when you let it just be. It doesn't need consistant watching and looking for it happen. It will happen, be sure of it, but be sure it happens when it's supposed to, and not when you make it.

#86016 131 2005-07-25T16:57:59Z maximo
The Daily Llama - Steamy Pile of PC

Appearance - 2 points
Cluttered and messy looking. Some seemingly random placed objects (which werent, but appeared to be) and just an overall unpolished look and feel to it.

Loading time/lag (the less there is, the higher the points) - 5 points
Less than a bar, super nice

Ease of use (if really cool tricks are easier to do it's a huge bonus) - 2 points
It seems all about falling, which isn't cool. Falling onto 4 slopes aren't cool, just easy. But it says cool tricks, so I dunno. Finding jumps to do was really hard in the mess of blocks and one ways. They were there, but they were hard to spot and excecute.

Fun factor (how fun is it to play?) - 10 points
Fun to mess around and get speed off of the falls, but other than that, there really isn't much to keep you entertain you here.

Quality & Quantity of cool stuff N can do on the map - 15 points
There is tons of quantity, but it's all about the same if you ask me. Lots of falls, lots of jump pads, and that's really about it. There was some cool things to land, but nothing stands out as a great jump or cool trick.

Ninja rating (how would I rate this map on NUMA if I didn't know it was linked to this competition?) - 1 points

Originality (pretty self explanatory) - 6 points
Very cool stuff in here, but it seems to be lacking in direction or order. I think you have great ideas, but it needs some organization.

Overall thoughts on map - 4 points
I think this map was just too cluttered and messy to be enjoyed the way some of the other maps are. The ability ot do big jumps, cool tricks and what not is really limited by the lack of open space for N to play in. Plus, the lack of a demo from you really hurts because I'm not sure what you had in mind at some points in the map.

TOTAL - 45 points. (I sure hope I added that right.

This bird might as well have been the Son of the Devil because if it were any uglier it would have been Lucifer himself. I wanted to scream in agony, running through town screaming "Godzilla!" but I figured that would be out of place at the moment. I sat in utter disgust, blinded by the suck that perched itself in front of me. I stared at it in disbilief, utterly flabergasted that anything so butt ugly could possibly still be alive. I blinked like they do in movies, desperatly hoping it was a dream or something less real, and go figure it didn't move. From the stupidly obesse beak sack to the redicuosly gargantuan feet things, the bird spelled "attracting" with two z's and a q (and that's not how you spell attacting, just incase you didn't know). I tried hard to will it to move, and it was like a stone. I screamed and it was like a deaf. I Signed "leave stupid" and it was blind. It was empervious to non physical attacks, so I decided to strap up. I went inside and got my peace, made sure it was ready for action, and went back out into the emotional warzone. While I turned the corner I wished the sun had finished it's job on my eyes so I didn't have to look at this being in front of me. If only I had stared at that eclipse, let the fireracker hit me in the face, seen if you really can poke an eye out (how do you poke in and have an eye come out... serriously). I finished turning the corner onto my deck and the monster was just as I had left it. I cocked my peace and let it fly. The dove flew right at the Pelican and hit it square in the face. The dove shrivelled up, turned brown, and died right there. I would too if I had to touch that thing. It fell off my deck like a rock and was headed strait for the rocky outcove below. Just then... it turned over and opened its mouth. The big pouch filled up like a parachute and the bird stopped falling. Why it didn't just spread it's wings, I don't know, but appearantly it was beat with the stupid stick as well as the ugly stick. So it's descent to impending doom was slowed and it landed without a scratch on the rocks. "Stupid beak sack," I muttered as I looked down at it in dismay. I turned around and started to head inside, I was tired after battle and needed a good sleep in a non-death-ugly zone (aka, my livingroom couch). Just then I tripped and fell on the dead dove and landed face first in a steamy pile of pelican poop. I just laid there, slain by the single dumbest creation ever. I would have gotten up but my ego was forever destined to be on the floor, and I couldn't leave my ego. I cried right there, for hours on end. Not like a whimpering cry, no deep, sobbing, chick flick movies that you lie about crying to tears. I died that night, not a physical death, but the death a man dies when he sees his son sign up for the cheerleading squad. I was never the same, partly because of that battle, but mostly because the humilation I suffered forced me to get a sex change.

#87953 309 2005-08-03T15:55:21Z maximo
as in total size, or tiles edited? and the pic I have puts my thoughts in words... one sec... I'll edit it into this post.

::edit::



Okay, case by case what I mean and you'll see how it all fits under one rule.

Case 1. (0 tiles) you can draw a box from the furthest out full piece to the corner and it covers ONLY full tiles, nothing else.

Case 2. (0 tiles) Same as above, but you draw 2 smaller boxes instead of just one. All the tiles still fit in the boxes so it is okay.

Case 3. (0 tiles) The long side is just one big box so it fits like Case 1. The 2x2 box works like Case 1 as well.

Case 4. (3 tiles) This doesn't work because if you draw a box from the the furthest tiles out (the three in the box) to the corner, there are empty tiles in that box. Therefore they don't fit and must be counted towards your total.

Case 5. (3 tiles) The two 3x1 lines of full tiles are fine. But the one floating full tile doesn't because there would be 3 empty tiles it the box. The slopes don't count because they are slopes...

Case 6. (1 tile, I forgot the red box... sorry) This is a simple case. Two boxes of full tiles that work fine, and the one slope in the corner.

Case 7. (15 tiles) None of these work for the same reason in Case 4.

Case 8. (3 tiles) All of these rules are already explained, they just are more complex here.

Case 9. (3 tiles) Two 2x1 boxes that are good and 3 sloped tiles that aren't.

Case 10. (5 tiles) 2x2 box...good, slopes and the one tile that would have non empty tiles in it's box... not good.

Case 11. (3 tiles) It's all explained, just more examples.

Case 12. (1 tile) Non full tiles, not good.

Case 13. (9 tiles) see case 7... which points to case 4, so go to case 4.

---

So it comes down to, can you draw a box to the corner of the map and have it only have full tiles in it. If not, then the boxes you can't do this to count. (oh yea, and the example I gave I realized, didn't work...so I'm dumb)

#90097 8 2005-08-12T04:02:51Z maximo
Why am I religious? That's a deep question and it'll take some time to explain, so please, bear with me.

First off, I'm 16 (I'm not really a youngun anymore, at least by these board's standards) and I've been a babtized believer for just over a year now. I have however known who the Christian God was my whole life. I was raised at first Catholic (for like 3 years) then Methodist (for 11). This doesn't mean I was abiding by these rules, just that I was labeled these things. When I was wee little, God was my super hero. He could fly and cast powerful spells and help me when I scraped my knee. That sorta blind faith a young kid raised in the Church has. However, at about age 12 I became analytical of my life and in particular my supposed faith. At my church no one had answers, at all. So slowly I talked myself out of church and God. I was first just a disbeliever and decided I didn't care enough to think about it anymore because I had already proved contrary. Then I started thinking again (I have oodles of free time and I just think and think) and I came to the short-lived conclusion that you can't possibly know for sure one way or the other (agnosticism). I mean, there was no apparent physical evidence for or against God because he was well, not of this universe supposedly. It was all fanciful and I rejected it. After a bit I came upon the belief of Deism and fell in line with it. I don't think science can or ever will be able to account for the creation of a universe (something I still believe) and Deism fit what I was looking for exactly. God made the place, hit play and is now watching us beat the crap out of each other laughing and sippin on a stoggie, probally toasting it up with Satan. Well you get the point, it was a joke to think God was still around, you couldn't see or feel or hear Him, just dumb to think He could do anything for me, so why live for him if He didn't care. Well this lasted for about 2 years and I was all "screw the world, it's going to Hell anways" with everyone I met and talked to. If it wasn't for numero uno, then it wasn't gonna get done, period. I mean I still was a good kid by today's standards, never once drank, smoke, partied, etc. (I'm not the social butterfly type). Well this sorta "whatever whatever" attitude led me into some pretty serious addictions (if you care to know what, PM me. I'll tell anyone who asks, but I don't do it in a public setting) and they pretty much owned my soul. No joke, Satan pwnd me. I no longer had control over my thoughts, time, actions, body. I mean I really was being led along like a blind, mute, deaf, quadraplegic by my personal longings and desires. I kept my habits secret and no one ever really found out... ever (until the aftermath when I told the people affected). Well this went on in increasing severity for about 5 months. What a freaking enjoyable time. I will not lie, what I was doing was really, really fun and easy to get. Well after a while I crossed some lines that I swore I would never cross, and it opened my eyes to the fact that I wasn't in control of my life anymore (again, this can be explained only in PM). I tried for about a month to stop on my own accord. No way I tell anyone, no way I seek help from anyone. This was my beef with me, and I was big enough to handle it. I wasn't, by any means. It only got worse for me, despite all my prolonged efforts. Pretty much I sucked at life for that month or so. Well, one night I was like... well man, this is stupid but I can't do it. Trust me, admitting defeat is not something someone like me does lightly. I came to the conclusion that asking God for help could do no possible harm, and could either do nothing, or good. What's to lose, right? I prayed the dumbest prayer ever. Pretty much I was mocking God while I asked for His help with my life. Well, quite to my surprise, slowly I saw a change. I could start saying "no" to myself, start walking away from what I wanted but knew couldn't have because it hurt other people. It was like the most radical change ever. Now your probably expecting me to say, "Well, that proved it, and I ran down to church jumped in a pool and was saved," but that's not how it went. It really only cracked the door open for me. It put the questions back in my head about whether or not God cared. I had to know man, I just had to. I started searching. Not really an aimed search, just looking for what was out there, strictly scientific. I analyzed and thought about everything I came across for a long time. I read a lot of books about what facts there were for the Christian faith, both for and against and to my surprise (and honestly to a little dismay) I found the evidence for God so much more convincing. I really don't feel like going into all I found because that is a whole 'nother conversation altogether. Suffice to say, I found a lot more convincing evidence (archaeological, scientific (physics and biology mostly), and a little other people (mostly 2 main players, one who is Agnostic, the other Christian). I used a lot of people as bouncing boards for what I found, and a lot of athiests really didn't have answers to some facts I was finding and telling them. My biology teacher who studied evolution pretty much fell on his face trying to defend his position (which I know, isn't a great task to topple a high school biology teacher, but the example remains). Well, that summer I went to a church conference called CiY (Christ in Youth). The auditorium was packed with about 3000 (I think that's the number, suffice to say it was a very large number) teens from all over the Midwest. During worship watching people around me who I figured people who were hopeless cases, or the other extreme already "right with God" crying, screaming, dancing, shouting, jumping, laughing, hugging, praying, etc. I could not help but think that maybe this evidence was deeper than some manuscripts found in a desert. I saw for the first time in my life God moving in a place. I mean, you really couldn't deny it sitting in that auditorium. People of all backgrounds and stories helpless to the power in this place. I mean, nothing shuts up 3000 teens like prayer. I mean even the rudest, most obnoxious people shut up for prayer in that place. They recognized something was there; whether or not they wanted it was another thing, but they knew they needed to shut up for probably the first time in their lives. I was one of those people. God didn't need silence because God didn't care. At least that is what I thought going into this conference. That soon changed. I couldn't help but feel the force in this place moving and working. Any thoughts of agnosticism were pretty much chrushed there, and really Deism was out the window. I was baptized at that conference and since have been passionately in love with God. I have slipped plenty of times (ugh...) and tried really hard to go back to my old ways, but God's love is too strongly revealed to me. My faith is built upon this foundation of fact and decorated with faith. I regularly pick up a discovery magazine and read what the new finds are to check my facts against the most recent finds. I still read and research my Faith extensivly. I check bible verses against the original Greek texts for accuracy, I check verses I don't understand with 2 different commentaries on the Bible and my youth minister (who is probally the most analytical guy I know other than me) and he *usually* has the answer. The times he doesn't I go to other sources (Internet, other teachers, magazines, etc.) It's a pretty thourough checking system to ensure what I put so much time to is what I should be doing. Right now is the best day of my life. It's not because I did anything cool or something cool happened to me. It's because today I got to hang out with the God of the universe, who loves me more than all of you put together could ever with all the time of this world ten times over. I mean, all the dumb stuff I did during those 5 plus months before I was baptized has been wiped away by the sacrifice God made because he loved me more than I can ever know. Every day is the best day of my life because of this love. Nothing I have ever tried or searched for has been better or more solidly built. I love God so much I couldn't tell you in a hundred posts this long. His love is all that matters to me. God isn't number one on my priorities list, He *is* the list. I can't really say much more. That's my story, start to finish. If you want to know the details and whatnot PM me (any of you) and I'll give ya the personal stuff.

You asked, I answered. Sorry for any typos, misspellings, or stupid grammar errors in there; I'm not the best speller or typist.

#91197 67 2005-08-15T05:06:07Z maximo
Talkshowhost... I've extensively researched the factuallity and reliabilty of the Bible because it is the basis of all Christian Faith. I'll try quickly to summarize the results of my findings. This will in no way be comprehensive and the numbers are heavily rounded from memory (I'm not good with specifics, but the point will still be clear I hope).

First off, I have a Greek-to-English interliterary Bible to check the original Greek against our translations.

The verse I tried to reference earlier is Romans 1:27 which reads

Quote: Romans 1:27 (NLV)
and in the same way also the men, giving up natural intercourse with women, were consumed with passion for one another. Men commited shameless acts with men and received in their own persons the due penalty for their error.

And the Greek word for word translation (this is in no way a complete English sentence; it's the Greek broken down by word and translated)

Quote
likewise indeed also the males having sent off the natural use of the female were burned thoroughly in the lust of them to one another, males in males the shamelessness working thoroughly and the return wage which it is necessary of the deceit of them in themselves reveiving back.

The phrase "males in males" uses the same word both times, so it clearly doesn't mean males and boys. In the preceding verse Paul says this, which isn't the topic, but applies none the less.

Quote: Rom 1:26 (NLV)
For this reason God gave them up to degrading passions. Their women exchanged natural intercourse for unnatural.

The Greek is too indecipherable to be of any use for 1:26. This verse clearly points out that males and males having intercourse is unnatural. And seeing as they were penalized for this, we can reach the conclusion it is a sin before God.

---

That pertained only to the topic at hand; now onto the validity of the Bible as a whole.

---

There are 2 known manuscripts telling of Hanibal crossing the Alps (or prynesses, I never can remember which one; it's insignicant. He crossed some mountains, as told in these accounts). Both are dated 100's of years after the event occurred which means they were passed down orally (most likely) and then written down later for record keeping. 2 copies. Both are widely different than each other in terms of minor details and extra facts. However, it is common knowledge and an indisputable fact that Hanibal did in fact cross these mountains. This is based solely on 2 accounts both 100's of years after the actual events happened.

There are around 5000 manuscripts of the New Testament. The earliest are dated even *conservatively* to about 50 years after the death of Christ (that is very conservative, mind you; recent reports date them as early as 2-30) which in archaeological terms a blink of an eye. And most manuscripts fall within two centuries of this time period. This is like a second to archaeologists. There is not enough time for them to be blown out of proportion because eyewitnesses still lived and would have spoke out against the lies. This is especially true because the Jews and the Romans were strongly opposed to this outburst of revolution. Had these claims been outlandish and untrue, they would have said so. They had the authority and people's favor to do these things and people would have listened to them because they were reputable eyewitnesses to the events being told in scripture. 5000 manuscripts, the earliest within 50 years of the events. This doesn't include the fact that there are only .5% words in dispute today in the entire New Testament. That's about 200 words, and none of them change the facts. Most are simple words like how many people were there at this time or what time of day it was, etc. None of them change or alter the facts recorded in the Bible. So nearly identical, the most manuscripts for any historical piece ever, astoundingly close time period to actual events, what other conclusion is there? Also, every translation you read today is done from the Greek texts. They don't take the NIV and translate it to the NLV. They take the Greek and translate it to all the versions you have today. It's all from source, and not from "well these guys said this and they said that, we like this guy more so well use his."

---

That is excessively summarized. Thislinky dink is a more organized version of my arguments and pretty much hits most of the same points I do, which is weird because I found that after I wrote all of that above. So to believe in what I read as true isn't a stretch at all. I check all I read against the original Greek to ensure the translation I'm reading is accurate; I have 2 different commentaries I check against each other for accuracy. What I read is what they wrote.

So in this universe there is an infinite chance of their not being other universes and there are being other universes. A physical impossiblitiy. One of the possibilites is that the universe is nothing, so you have infinite repetions of this possiblity (because all possibilities would be fulfilled infinity times). So you have equal number of non existing universes and existing universes. You argue from the point that there is without a shadow of a doubt infinite universes. I do not think infinities can exist in reality. It's a non real term I believe.

If i have infinte marbles and I give you all of them, I have none. infinity-infinity=0
If I have infinite marbles and I give you two of them, I still have infinity infinity-2=infinity
If I have infinite marbles and give you half of them; infinity/2=infinity

those are three impossible situations together mathmatically. There are more you can do using this

#6044 1 2006-01-04T20:25:35Z maximo
Okay, this is sort of long and semi complex but I'll try my best (you all know I suck at explaining things).

Here we go,

Okay, so a map has 5 votes: 3.5, 4, 4, 3.5, 5 (avg score 4)

That's the normal system, here is my further more compelx systems:

The voters avg score (respectfully): 3.5, 4, 2.5, 2.5, 5 (total: 49)

and I know that no one has an avg score of 5, but it's an example...

okay, so now you take the average score of the voter and divide by the total of average scores (finding their percentage of influence on the vote)

this comes out to: .2, .23, .14, .14, .29 (again, respectfully)

Now multiply their vote by their percentage of influence: .7, .92, .56, .49, 1.45

And add that together: 4.15 (that is the new map score).

---

Under that system, people with higher avg score (obviously people better able to discern a good map, because they make them) have more weight in the vote. so when someone with a 1.5 avg rating comes and votes a map a .5 (this system would have to get rid of 0 as a possible score, really the only downside I see so far, apart from the confussion) they have much less influence than the other members. Also, people with no average rating could just be considered 1 or 2.5 or something like that so they still have a say, just not as much as say a baraba or nevermore. Also, this system doesn't change scores dramatically because it only shifted this .15 (not much). Only thing is I don't think arachnid tracks who voted what... that might be a problem.

Again, I know this is semi confusing, but I think it's a good solution to snipping because I hate seeing repost after repost, it gets annoying and I hate hearing complaints and stuff. Oppinions?

@lucidium: It's very checkable, and not a lot of work really. it's not exact for sure, but you can easily tell. All you do is take time remaining from level zero. Say 70 seconds. If while watching the run from the next map the time ever dips below 20 it would be a death. Say they however finished with that map with 60 seconds. They have so far spent 20+30 seconds, so they start the next map with 40 seconds. If they ever dip below 50 seconds left they would be dead. #157506 2 2006-03-24T20:16:00Z maximo
I'm just gonna say the overriding themes there is very broadly stated:



Form

Function

Flow

Simplicity - how i wish that stated with an "f"

Uniqueness - although this I would say is mostly a user level trend



and now I'm just gonna quote something I always give people who ask me how to make maps




Quote
1. The most important rule of mapmaking: playtest, playtest, playtest! Make sure every part of your map is both beatable and fun. Even if it is beatable, it may be just too frustratingly difficult for most people, which is not a good thing.



2. Make sure every single item has a purpose. Right down to the last piece of gold, ensure that everything in your map has a reason for being there. If it doesn't need to be there, take it out. It's okay to use gold and whatnot for aesthetic purposes, just in moderation.



3. Ensure that every part of your map goes with the others. In other words, let each part share the theme. For example, this theme could be an enemy type, an interesting style of tileset, or making use of a specific ability. Use this theme throughout the map. You don't have to do this, but most good maps do. And if you can find a concept to base a map on that hasn't been used before, that's all the better.



4. Develop your own unique style. If you look at one of maximo's or LV's maps, you can immediately tell who made it. You can use symmetry, item placement, enemy types, and much more to aid you.

#7649 1 2006-03-26T06:28:14Z maximo
Quote
Theme: Episodes



This go around we are asking for a 5 map episode.  The maps are to be episodic in nature and all that jazz.  I'll explain the scoring shortly.  The rules are simple and are as follows:



-No bugs, if metanet doesn't use it, you don't.

-All episodes must be submited in txt format attached to a post here or linked to a hosting service that has it. (ihud is good place to host if you need a place to host a file)

-No editing of maps once they are judged, this is gonna go on honor system, so please, if you are caught, you will suffer an undisclosed penalty, and trust me, you wont like it

-All authors are allowed 1 submissions, period.  This is because we have to judge five maps per submission.  So take your time and don't rush in your submission, because you can't submit then resubmit and just replace your old submission.  Once you submit it is your final submission.  You may edit a map until it is confirmed as submitted (as in i'll post and say you can't edit anymore because i'm going to dl all these into one file for the judges)

-Deadline for submissions will be I haven't decided yet, we'll see how it goes, you will have at least a 1 week warning before it's over though.

-Seeing as all scoring systems is based on judges discression, there will be a zero tollerance for any arguing of scores... if you would like to discuss a score, carry it out via PM's with that judge in question. (aka, don't complain to me about someone elses review)

-it is your responsibility to check all scoring for your maps, not ours (and please check our math)

-if I forgot something, it's common sense, don't be underhanded, and it should be fine. 



And now for scoring:



(0-5) Aesthetics: Do the maps look nice.  I know this seems arbitrary to some, but it is important that you have some concept of form in your maps.

(0-5) Rythem: Do your maps have a flow to them.  Do they work well for getting the gold.  Are routes avaliable that play well and fit the map and enemies.  This will be one of the harder catagories to get all 5 points on.

(0-5) Difficulty: Are your maps ascending in difficulty, does the gold provided fit well with how the maps play in time for an episode.  Are the maps NUMA hard or are they episode hard (and episode hard is less hard btw).  If you wanted a benchmark for difficulty, shoot mid-late 70's coloumn or less. 

(0-5) Length: is this episode gonna take me 5 hours, because if so that could be a problem.   The maps need to keep in mind that there are 5 of them and not just one (i'm a map consler on the weekends)

(0-5): Consitancy: do your maps suck half way through or do they shine throughout.  Making sure each map is as good as the others is very important here.  And just so you know, this means consitantly good.  Don't think putting up strait garbage will bag you 5 points here.

(0-25): Judges oppinion: This is where you make your money.  You need to impress the judges, and really just make your maps stick in their minds because we are gonna play a lot of maps and this is where you win or loose.  Your maps need to convince us we are playing episodes made for the real deal.  I want to forget i'm not playing the real game while playing your maps.  Wow us and you'll get a bucket of points hot and fresh.



Judges: Me, [working on it]

Back up judge: Clovic

Quote
Barbed Wire: The barb effect is quite cool, although aside from that the map is somewhat bland.



Beware of the Puppies: Very simple but interesting use of precision timing.



Cathedral: A nice idea. Could probably be implemented a little better, but the idea itself is solid.



Central Dense Overcast: Nothing really exciting here.



Fillin' In Time: Ah, now here's a good one. The enemy combination makes it pretty intense. I'd suggest moving the exit up a snap and a half or so, though.



Peekaboo: Holy crap! Yet another concept that I've already made into an Expanse map! Very nice job.



Sidle: What the heck? Am I missing something, or is this not beatable?

The Displaced: Unbelievably awesome idea, but not right for Legacy. Submit this to Numa, por favor.



Why won't you leave me alone?: Kinda weird, kinda cool. Don't know about this one, really.



A Mean-spirited or spiteful remark: Nice nice. Would be fantastic as a very early level.

Troglophile: Standard puzzle fare. Try not to make too many of these, okay?



13.6 MK: Stunning tileset. I actually found this really easy and not frustrating at all.



Confinement: A very odd array of bounce blocks and switches. I liked it for the most part though.



Equidistant: The bounce block mechanism works incredibly well, but all the gold pieces should be moved down a quarter snap so each top one doesnt overlap.



Mishmash: Decent. Cant think of much to say.

#8951 1 2006-05-23T20:31:33Z maximo
I'm going to be storing my fan fic here.  It's in it's early stages now but feel free to read and critique.  




Quote
~~~



Eyes closed, one palm facing the grey clouds above and one facing the gently blowing grass below Nijin meditated intently upon his training.  He reflected upon the last five years of his life here at the Doki Gardens.  Gardens is misleading, it was more of a shrine, temple even, located next to the Doki River.  The grounds were roughly five square miles of thick bamboo forest, five small white pagodas marking the corners of the gardens.  At the center was the Shrine of Doki, which had existed for many centuries as the center of Way.  



Nijin recounted his first impressions of the Shrines elaborate spires and floating rooms.  Parts of the Shrine sat directly above the Doki River below, levitating over the currents below, held in place by the monks who channeled their minds through the Shrine.  



A group of these monks were sitting on one of the concentration platforms in a traditional Way meditation stance, using their combined efforts to keep the platform stable in the air.  When the wind picked up the platform started to tilt and wobble but the monks did not break meditation and held the platform aloft.  As the winds continued to increase however the let the platform slowly drop back into its place and walked inside after ceremonially coming out of meditation. 



Nijin remembered coming here as a teen, much older than most that arrive as infants, and he was looked at as an outcast by his peers.  He was however quick to learn the grounds and adapt to his surroundings.  He remembered skipping sleep to walk the grounds and memorize the gardens he now called home.  Within a few months he knew the gardens as well, if not better, as any other student his age.  



Nijin focused upon his teachers over the years; most notable of course was his Way Father, Kokije.  Every student had a Way Father or Mother, and they were the students personal instructors into Way.  Kokije had chosen Nijin shortly after he arrived in Doki.  It was Kokije who instilled the drive into Nijin to excel beyond his peers who had been here for many years more than he.  



Kokije was a member of the Higher Council at the time and was seated above all but two other monks.  Being selected by the third highest monk in Doki was an honor Nijin could barely understand in his ignorant youth.  Kokije had taught all but one of the grand monks of the current era, a feat unmatched in ages past.  Kokije was arguably the greatest teacher at the time of Nijins arrival, and Nijin would be his first student in nine years, a fact that did not escape the eyes of the Higher Council.



It was also Kokije who had given Nijin his name.  Nijin means fated one and many at the time speculated that Kokije saw Nijin as a special boy.  Nijins birth name was Hon-Burein, Burein being his hometown.  Burein is located about a thousand miles east of Doki in the province of Sorreina.  Hon-Burein had made the journey alone after escaping his home to follow Way.  Way was outlawed in Sorreina and practicing it by punishable with death.  Hon-Burein had heard about the Doki Gardens and strived for them since youth.  When he was old enough to make the journey he left under the cover of darkness and traveled west for six months until reaching the Doki River and a group of monks who pointed him upstream towards the Shrine.



The soft rain drops on his arms broke Nijins trance as he returned to this plane of thought.  He thought of his first feeble training sessions with Kokije as he walked back to the Shrine and his cot, he smirked at his past failures.  The rains came quickly and forcefully in Doki.



~~~ 


#179537 2 2006-05-23T20:32:07Z maximo
post 2!




Quote
~~~ 



The dust flew up around Nijin as he was slammed and slid across the ground.  Kokije stood above him and looked down upon a now limp Nijin.  



Why not stand? Kokije asked, pressuring Nijin to regain his feet.  What holds you to the ground?



Nijin pushed against the ground with what little strength he had and raised his battered body no more than a foot when his wobbling arms gave out and he collapsed in a plume of dust.



Father, my imperfections hold me here.  "I can not stand under their weight, came the answer from the bleeding lips of Nijin.



Kokije extended an arm to Nijin who grasped it loosely as he was pulled to a standing position.  



Defend yourself! Kokije demanded as his arm came around his body to strike Nijin.  Nijin raised a weak defense that Kokijes attack easily broke through, striking Nijin under his chin.  Again Nijin found himself on the dirt being looked down upon by his Way Father.



What is wrong Nijin; you know your flaws and yet do not correct them?  Until you take your knowledge and form it in your life you will never transcend.  Kokije again extended his arm to lift Nijin from the ground, but Nijin was too winded to grab it.  This is where you are now Nijin, you see my arm and are aware it will lead to you standing, yet you do not take it.  Your pain now will pale in comparison to what pain awaits you outside of these gardens, if you can not take my arm now under light pains how then can you transcend under the actual pain of the world?  You can not.  Now take my arm and stand.



Nijin willed every last bit of energy into his arm and raised it to grab Kokijes.  He was pulled to his feet and stood unsteadily before his Way Father.  He turned to look him in the face, I do not expect to suffer Father.  



Kokije stood to his full height and looked with compassion upon his student.  Placing his hand on Nijins shoulder he spoke, Then you have underestimated the task that is before you Nijin.  Kokije removed his hand and Nijin collapsed under his own weight.  Kokije knelt and left a wrapped bit of gold by his students side before turning and leaving him in the clearing.  Tonight was a Way passing, which signified the end of a month in Doki.  



A month lasts ninety days in Doki, and signifies the life and death of Gannei N, the founder of Way.  Gannei, when he embarked on the path to transcendence, did not consume anything in order to meditate without ceasing.  After ninety days of constant meditation he envisioned transcendence for the first time.  He came out of meditation and realized the futileness of this life and allowed one of his students to kill him so that he could enter blissful transcendence.  As he died he explained the path, but his words exact are lost to history, what remains is a belief that meditation can lead to transcendence, and only through intense training can it be achieved.



He was dead, but in death he showed a way for those who follow him to reach transcendence without death.  Every Way passing was a celebration of his death and sacrifice by the necessary eating of gold.  Way monks did not eat at any other time, but instead fasted to focus their minds on their training and tasks.  This eating was an acknowledgement that their current bodies could not live without indulging, and only when they transcended could they refuse their bodies completely and be with Gannei N in Transcendence.  Gannei remains the only one to have seen transcendence in this life, still though, Way monks hold prophecy that there will come another who will possess the knowledge to not just see, but fully transcend in this life.



~~~ 


#179538 3 2006-05-23T20:32:47Z maximo
Day three, hooray.




Quote
~~~ 



Blurred bamboo shoots shot past his face on either side.  The barely discernable shape of his goal could be seen a few hundred feet ahead, ducking and twisting to avoid colliding with the foliage around them.  At these speeds you dont have time to think, so much as just react.  Nijin could feel his lungs straining to match his bodys needs and he willed them to keep going.  His goal flashed before him again, just before it ducked off to the left, never once missing a stride.  



Nijin new this part of the garden from walks he had taken upon arriving in Doki.  While running he plotted the course for where his prey would most likely be going.  Just as he figured it out he collided with an outcropping of bamboo.  His chest turned to the right, his arms and legs flailing as they turned with his body.  He was lifted off his feet and fell on his back, his left leg bent awkwardly under his body.  



He gasped to regain his breath and looked down the path to the left of him.  He saw his prize duck in and out of the clearing a mere twenty feet ahead of him, oblivious to the fact its pursuit had ended abruptly.  Nijin slammed his fist into the ground, furious he had let it escape and failed his mission.  



He laid there for some time before he heard a rustling behind him.  He strained his neck to look and see who it was but before he could Kokije was standing over him speaking, Son, why did you fail?



The words were stern and guiding, like everything Kokije spoke.  Nijin responded, still winded, Father, my impurities blinded me to what lay ahead.



No! Kokije yelled as he reached down and struck Nijin across the face with an open hand, You did not want to succeed, and so you did not.  You must want what you desire so greatly nothing else can stop you.  What do you desire Nijin?



Nijin wiped his chin of the blood that had started to run onto it before speaking, I desire the end of impurities and transcendence.  Nijin coughed and spit the blood from his mouth onto the ground.



Then you must crave to the ends of the realm, only then can you reach your destiny, Kokije knew he would regret those words as soon as he spoke them.  He had desired to keep those thoughts private until Nijin was of age to begin his mission.  Kokije knew Nijins natural inquisitiveness would mill over the words until he had an answer.  



Nijin, its time for you to know your fate, Kokije spoke slowly and softly, not his typical fatherly tone, It is your destiny to follow in Gannei Ns path.



Nijins tired mind raced for an answer as it struggled to form words, Butuhdont we?  He trailed off as his mind attempted to digest the information.



The other members of the Council do not agree with my evaluation.  You are not to speak of this to anyone, Kokije spoke again with great concern in his voice for his students future.



Nijin was still scrambling for answers as he asked, But dont we all follow His path, isnt that the fate of all of us?



Kokije regretted this conversation but knew he had to answer Nijins questions.  We do, yes, but you must follow him in this life and transcend before death, Kokije spoke while extending a hand to pick up Nijin.



Nijin spoke while standing, But Father, why has this fallen upon me?



It is your fate, son.



~~~

#9457 1 2006-06-14T03:46:33Z maximo
Theme: Episodes



This go around we are asking for a 5-map episode.  The maps are to be episodic in nature and if you want a bench mark, go play Metanet maps and not the userlevel packs floating around.  I'll explain the scoring shortly.



The rules are simple and are as follows:



-No bugs.  If Metanet doesn't use it, you don't.

-All episodes must be submitted in .txt format attached to a post here or linked to a hosting service that has it (iHud is good place to host if you need a place to host a file [Also, keep in mind that ihud files *do* expire, so keep your hard-copy so we can reference it if it does go away]).

- The levels should be in userlevel format, which if you don't know goes as follows:

$name of map#your name#nedcon#map data#

-No editing of maps once they are judged.  This is gonna go on an honor system, so please, if you are caught, you will suffer an undisclosed penalty, and trust me, you won't like it.

-All authors are allowed 1 submission, period.  This is because we have to judge five maps per submission.  So take your time and don't rush in your submission, because you can't submit then resubmit and just replace your old submission.

-Once you submit it is your final submission.  You may edit a map until it is confirmed as submitted (as in I'll post and say you can't edit anymore because I'm going to put all these into one file for the judges).

-I've decided a deadline, see below.

-Seeing as all scoring is based on judges' discretion, there will be a zero tolerance for any arguing of scores.  If you would like to discuss a score, carry it out via PMs with the judge in question (aka, don't complain to me about someone else's review).

-It is your responsibility to check all scoring for your maps, not ours (and please check our math).

-You can not use pre-existing maps in your episodes.

-If I forgot something, it's common sense.  Don't be underhanded, and it should be fine.



Scoring is as follows:



Every episode will be compiled and placed in one master .txt file.  Willing members of the Legacy elite alumni will play through the levels and vote for their favorite 3 episodes from all the entires.  The ten episodes recieving the most votes will be our finalist episodes.
