#365124 27 2007-09-15T07:02:52Z maximo
a day in the life: Gosh this is fun but hard.  The only part that was odd was how you have to get to the bottom left switch, it just feels awkward, other than that this is saucy hardness, just Like I like it.



a foriegn land: I hate maps were the only real "threat" is a tricky jump like this.  I can do it consitantly, I'm just questioning wether or not that is fun to do, if you take away that little part of beign stuck in the room the map flows and plays great, so I recomend removing the jump pad there and just making it normal.  Again, that's me though.



at peace in my castle: don't change a thing.  I really liked the thwumps, they were just a very unconventional addition and really were neat.



attain wave: I hate the required jump in this map, I really really do.  I dunno what else to say.  It's not bad, it's just so against what I like.



be bold: I really like the routes and the drone timing, good stuff.



black market: I'm not sure how I feel about the bottom, maybe too hard to get teh gold with teh mines and the laser, but the top is nifty.  Reminds me of your map from expanse with the chain guns.



chockful: I don't like getting tot he switch, the way on the left has the stupid mine to block the way and piss you off and the way on the right has that tricky corner you have to just squeeze by...again this is tastes.  I did it, but it wasn't enjoyable to get tot he switch (I went the left way btw).



chutes and jaggers: beautiful and fun, just perfect.  Reminiscent of hyroglyphics from the 80's.



convenently hidden: minimalism done right, great job.



cowardice: metanet like to the t man, and done with gusto.



Eureka: Thwump running, such a classy idea and I like how it's used here, the spacing and layout is very race like without feeling linear, I liked it a lot.



exile: at first I wanted to hate this map, but it's very addicting and very fun, I think it's a tad ahrd to get into the top sections of gold but it's not a problem that needs solved really, the map works overall very well.



fatigue sets in: this has greatness written all over it, please don't touch it, it's great.



fiesta of doom: I can't beat it, and I really hate climbers so I just wont even pass judgement.



final transmission: This isn't my favorite of maps with this theme, it's good, just not as good as it could be.



firewall: hard but stupidly fun, I love thwump wall maps



huddle: good, not much else to say, a bit weird to traverse at times.



Hang up on options: reminds me of Kevin's stuff, and that's always good.  really good actually.



I.never.knew: good take on an old idea.



interlock: not sure I like the difficulty, but it's a great idea, maybe make the floor gaurds path one tile longer? I dunno how to do that, but it's tough, maybe too tough...



jagged halls: ah good map.



jello: you know I love this.



jones: this bored me a little, the climb was too repetative and it was slow.  I dunno, a good entry level climber if that's what you're going for.



just make it through today: this is what i'm talking about, I love this mess



like a bridge: this is just the perfect map for the 4 slot of an early episode.  I love it, and pretty too.



lure: this is one stupidly tough cookie to crack but man it's so fun.  It's long and maybe you should put 3 or so gold in each cell but man it's fun, it's just so f'n hard.  I played it for like an hour.



monster waves: this is insanely fun to all gold.  I love the dual use of the bounce blocks to get up top and save your fall, well planned.	



neosurrealism: this map suffers from "where the hell do I go" syndrome.  It needs some gold or something to help the player know what the objectives are. With sucha  big open map it's not easy to pick up on what's expected of you, and that's a bad thing.



Odd one out: you're f'n evil.  If there was any way this could be less trial and error it would be better, but it's not.  darn cool idea for numa, but i dunno about episodes.  It seems to fit "&" well though.



one minute map: good, very solid and minimalistic which i'm always down with.



overwhelming: Good idea, i'm just not sure it's fleshed out well though, it jsut feels underdeveloped.



pedastal: once you get the exit switch the map is boring and the walk to the exit sucks but it's great otherwise.  Maybe it's just the route I took though, so take that with a grain of salt because this map kicked ass.



perimeter: this is saucy, hard and kinda ugly, but great fun.



persistant, aren't they?: this map just defies you to go for teh gold, and it's awsome fun, not hard though, i thought it would be.  great mid coloumn map.



pier: this is so amazing, the first drop to the gold is just stupidly fun, you don't use those chain guns alot and when you do you usually corner them (probally for predictability) but I really like when you do, it comes out well.



reverse icarus: I like it, good fun jumper without any tricks up it's sleeve.



room runner: the seeker drone is no fun, it's just piss awful in that room and it's a neccessary room and that pisses me off.  The map is also pitfalled by the "lots of little challenges that add up to to frustration and retry after rety of dying in step 1 just to try step 2 again and again." problem.  I dunno, not my thing, not my style.  Cool idea, jsut too frustrating imo, maybe if you nixxed that seeker it would be better, switch it to a gauss?



scaling the hotel walls: sick, I told you I like when you use chain guns.



shiney consulate: fun but a bit cluttered, it plays really well though.



stakeout: c snap up the gold and move it up in the coloumns and I think we have a winner, as is it's too technical for an episode.



storage chamber: simple fun really, clean and simple.  I like it, but it's not as good as your other stuff.



teleblok: simply great, I love the concept and execution is top notch.



the dynasty continues: awsome man, I love this.



the grand stream: this is a lot like my map, though I don't remember which one, but it just instantly made me think of it.  I thinki t's expanse but I'm not sure.  I like it, this is better and prettier than mine.  Great work.



the sky is my home: super duper and just plain fun, which is what we're going for.



unlax: this was very unique and very fun.  Unique is what I like the most though.



unsheltered: 1st try missed only 5 gold, but man that was great fun, rockets & bounce blocks are my favorites, mix in a great drone path and simple design and we have a winner here.



vortex: this is really really neat, really really cool, and really really fun.



we've been waiting: this felt subpar really, just not what the rest of your set has been like in terms of polish and fun.



whatever works: this was great man, awsome timing on the drones, the rockets were just intense enough.  well done.  On a whole this pack has such a high level of polish it's sickening (in a good way).



"whew"
